name: LazyTabWrapper
description: LazyTabWrapper - Wrapper for lazy-loaded tab components with Suspense
descriptionFull:
LazyTabWrapper - Wrapper for lazy-loaded tab components with Suspense

Handles lazy loading with a fallback spinner while the component loads. Useful for code-splitting large tab components

props.name: data
props.description: Data to pass to the component

props.name: spinnerType
props.description: Spinner type when using default fallback
